patthana17.31:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana17.31:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassanasappaṭigho na asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.31:3.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na asaṅkiliṭṭhaasaṅkilesiko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. sanidassanattika vitakkattike nasanidassanattika navitakkattikaṃ
